mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines in the prior month but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in a month but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the following 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate weakening demand that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the prior month but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the following 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 100) intensifies supply chain disruptions, increasing input costs and reducing corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 100 and S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the following 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust economic activity that supports earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases in the prior quarter but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the following 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the prior month but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 60% of the following 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing expansion (INDPRO above 100) supports increased production capacity and corporate output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO exceeds 100 and S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of the following 60 trading days.
